scope.summary: Replace the date-gated Development pilot allowlist with a tested fail-closed Copilot eligibility policy and actionable merge diagnostics, preserving all native GitHub gates.
implemented: Tested Copilot-only eligibility for same-repository PRs targeting copilot/Development, with no creation-date cutoff and fail-closed reasons.
Actionable diagnostics for drafts, requested reviewers, mismatched PR metadata, and missing, pending or failed required checks.
Read-only policy tests for pull_request events; write-capable merge job checks out trusted copilot/Development.
Native squash auto-merge retained without draft promotion, force push, or protection bypass.

criteria.description: Tests prove legacy-date Copilot PRs can be considered safely without approving untrusted or mismatched PRs.

evidence.reference: tests/phase2-automerge-policy.test.mjs: allows existing and future Copilot PRs without using a creation-date cutoff
evidence.outcome: Passes for a date before the former cutoff and a future date using the same fail-closed predicate.

criteria.description: Ineligible PRs get actionable diagnostic reasons.

evidence.reference: tests/phase2-automerge-policy.test.mjs: rejects mismatched and unsafe PR metadata with actionable reasons
evidence.outcome: Passes for closed, wrong-base, fork, wrong-head namespace, wrong-author, draft, pending-review and incomplete metadata cases.
Workflow reports missing, pending and failed required checks separately.

evidence.reference: tests/phase2-automerge-policy.test.mjs: workflow retains required CI and native squash auto-merge without draft promotion
evidence.outcome: Passes assertions for both required gates, native squash-only auto-merge, no draft promotion, no admin bypass, and no old pilot exceptions.

criteria.description: Scoped PR and CI results linked here and on farbotkol/butterbox#282; no automatic merge claimed until demonstrated.

evidence.outcome: Read-only PR policy test passed; merge job skipped for the pull_request event.
Verify failed at the missing attempt-specific JSON evidence marker; database was pending at record time.
Parent scope linked in PR #284; no real eligible auto-merge has been demonstrated or claimed.

criteria.description: If Copilot dispatch is unavailable, record blocker with precise permissions/capability, do not claim an agent started.

evidence.outcome: The current implementation is scoped to this active PR; no additional task was dispatched and no second agent start is claimed. Copilot CLI repair authentication remains unproven.

tests.result: 4 focused policy and workflow-guard tests passed.
ESLint passed on the changed JavaScript files.

decisions: Treat all PR eligibility dates alike but require a Copilot author, same-repository head, exact Development target, non-draft status, complete reviewer metadata and no pending reviewer requests.
Leave branch protections and repository settings unchanged; native GitHub auto-merge remains the only merge path.
Do not claim automatic merging or Copilot CLI repair authentication until demonstrated.
limitations: The live ruleset applying to copilot/Development could not be queried through the available GitHub read surfaces; approval and conversation-resolution settings require owner verification.
No open Copilot-authored Development PR was found; the only open PR returned, #284, is draft and authored by farbotkol.
PR review/thread queries for the historical pilot PRs returned no current review data and cannot establish historical approval requirements.
The successful PR policy run is dry-run/read-only and does not demonstrate a merge.
Copilot CLI authentication for a personally owned repository remains unproven.
blockers: The attempt-specific evidence marker has not yet been reconciled into the remote PR body; Verify must be rerun after it is added.
The current PR remains draft and current-head verify/database success and a real eligible auto-merge have not been demonstrated.
The owner must inspect Development ruleset approvals and conversation-resolution requirements before deciding whether zero required human approvals are appropriate.
